label: Verdict Scorecard -- evidence, then the verdict
description: Evidence, then the verdict: criteria rows tick one by one (a circle fills, a check draws), then a dark tile lands the verdict ('Top 5%', 'Qualified', 'A+'). Use it for an assessment beside an interview, a lead score, an audit result -- any 'it checked these, so this' beat. 3-5 criteria. Wide boxes put the tile beside the list, tall boxes under it; size it with its box. Pairs with video-call. Anchors: card (the panel), number (the verdict tile).

criteria.label: The checks, in order: [{label, pass: false for a miss (red ring, no tick), at: scene seconds (word anchor) when it ticks}] or plain strings

title.label: Small caps header ('Runneth assessment · Lena S.')

count.label: Count the verdict's number up as it lands

at.label: When the panel rises (scene seconds, default 0.2)

stagger.label: Seconds between ticks (default: shared from the scene, 0.3-0.6)

verdict_at.label: When the verdict lands (default: just after the last tick)
